summary: D05 keeps the writing, record and money core intact (all Age facts, the research-stage atom stamp_seal and every civic prerequisite keep their ids and consumers) and makes four kinds of change. (1) Causal placement: the printing and finance nodes that ADR-029 rule R1 put in Engineering only because they are A6+ (woodblock_print, both movable types, paper_money, bill_of_exchange, printing_press) move to the trunk; printing is a craft innovation that did not need organized scholarship, and all their prerequisites are already trunk. With D01's heavy_plough relocation A6 entry becomes stage-free, but A7 entry stays stage-coupled through its technological/systemic supporting facts (D04/D08 nodes), so this is causal hygiene, not a pacing fix. printing_press's factors are kept in this file; at integration D05 accepts D07's re-pointed type_founding as its precondition with a material re-score (36,490 vs 39,780 RP), conditional on type_founding also moving to the trunk. (2) Two bundle splits that conserve or reduce workload: radio -> wireless telegraphy (key kept, re-dated A8) + radio_broadcasting, removing the vacuum_tube causal inversion; satellite -> orbital satellite (key kept, material re-scored) + communications_satellite. (3) Four new nodes with real dependencies or owners: mesoamerican_script (the independent calendar-rooted invention of writing, requested by D03 for the Maya mathematical tradition), automatic_switching (cellular and relay-computing base), punched_card_tabulation (administrative data processing; gives jacquard a dependant), optical_telegraph (pre-electric state signalling for M7/M8). (4) Dead ends resolved by owners or requested dependants (movable_type_metal, fibre_optics, cellular_digital), and capability blocks for all 30 nodes (trade's auto-fill owner corrected). The stored-program computer split belongs to D06 and is requested with a concrete design. Other lanes' requests accepted at integration (they name new ids): radio <- electromagnetic_field_theory (D04), hacksilver <- cupellation (D02); submarine_cable now requires steamboat (D08).

existing.rationale: VERDICT: typographic printing is a craft innovation - a goldsmith's adjustable hand mould and type-metal alloy, oil-based ink and a screw press adapted from wine, oil and paper presses (Mainz c. 1450); it did not causally need organized scholarship. All three prerequisites (casting_closed, mechanics_archimedean, paper) are already trunk, so nothing else moves. The Engineering placement came from ADR-029 rule R1 (by Age), not from causality. Prerequisites and factors re-checked: no D05-internal split (mould, alloy, ink and press only work together as the Gutenberg system), but the causally prior type-casting half already exists as D07's type_founding, which D07 re-points to casting_closed; D05 accepts making the press require it at integration with a matching material re-score (see changes). Effects in the lane notes (A7 entry: unchanged in practice; patent: stage no longer in its closure).

crossLaneRequests.request: Split computer (535,250 RP) into causally distinct parts: a programmable-computation part (Zuse Z3 1941, Colossus 1943-44, ENIAC 1945) with prerequisite '(vacuum_tube OR automatic_switching) AND calculus' (optionally AND punched_card_tabulation for card/tape input-output), and the retained computer = stored-program electronic computer (Manchester Baby 1948, EDSAC 1949) requiring that part AND vacuum_tube. D05 does not create these ids, to avoid collisions; automatic_switching and punched_card_tabulation are D05 NEW ids, so reference them at integration.
